research_object_baseline_note: One RIZ -> one T0 -> its own exit boundary -> its own minute film. Film-1 ends at the first post-T0 minute whose range meets that RIZ's exit boundary. Cards written before this date are 'not carried over' by default: they measured T0-minute packets, fixed windows called films, or geometry anchored on t0_close. See AGENTS.md, GLOSSARY.md, reference/SCENE.md and base/README.md.
